chunk: description: Canonical model for return and refund records — covers RMA, return authorization, refund amount, restocking status. Synced bidirectionally between e-commerce and ERP.
createdFrom: homage engagement (2026-05-19) — Shopify ↔ NetSuite returns/refunds sync (UC2)
note: "Stub — created from homage engagement. Promoted to versioned schema when confirmed fields from 2+ clients."

properties:
  returnId:
    type: string
    description: Canonical return/RMA identifier
  externalReturnId:
    type: string
    description: Source-system return ID
  orderId:
    type: string
    description: Canonical order identifier the return is against
  externalOrderId:
    type: string
    description: Source-system order ID
  customerId:
    type: string
    description: Canonical customer identifier
  status:
    type: string
    enum: [pending, approved, received, refunded, rejected, cancelled]
    description: Return status
  returnReason:
    type: string
    description: Reason for return (e.g. defective, wrong_item, changed_mind)
  lineItems:
    type: array
    items:
      type: object
      properties:
        itemId:
          type: string
        sku:
          type: string
        quantity:
          type: integer
        refundAmount:
          type: number
  refundAmount:
    type: number
    description: Total refund amount in settlement currency
  refundCurrency:
    type: string
    description: ISO 4217 currency code
  restockItems:
    type: boolean
    description: Whether returned items are added back to inventory
  createdAt:
    type: string
    format: date-time
  resolvedAt:
    type: string
    format: date-time
    description: ISO 8601 timestamp when refund was issued
